userStories.title: Add position time limit and staleness alerts to range_exit_monitor.py
userStories.description:
Current state: range_exit_monitor.py at businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/range_exit_monitor.py only exits on stop_loss or target_hit. There is no time limit — positions can sit open indefinitely.

What to build:
1. Add time-based checks to check_positions():
   - Parse entry_ts from each position (ISO format string)
   - Calculate hold_hours = (now - entry_ts).total_seconds() / 3600

   Time limits:
   - hold_hours >= 336 (14 days): Send Telegram WARNING 'Position X open for {days} days'
   - hold_hours >= 720 (30 days): Force exit with reason 'time_limit'

2. Constants at module level:
   WARN_HOURS = 336    # 14 days
   FORCE_EXIT_HOURS = 720  # 30 days

3. Log the time limit exit to range_trade_log.jsonl (using the logging pattern from rt-exit-logging US-001).

4. Only send the 14-day warning once per position (check if a 'warned_stale' flag exists in the position, set it after first warning).

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify range_execute.py, range_scanner.py, or range_signal_filter.py
- Time limit exits must still call sell_token() and log the trade
- Handle missing entry_ts gracefully (skip time check if not present)

userStories.title: Add dynamic S/R refresh to range_exit_monitor.py — update stop/target on each check
userStories.description:
Current state: range_exit_monitor.py uses the static stop_loss and exit_price that were calculated at entry time. Support and resistance shift over time — if the range narrows or moves, the original levels become stale.

What to build:
1. In check_positions(), for each open position:
   - Fetch fresh OHLCV candles (import get_ohlcv from range_scanner)
   - Recalculate S/R (import calculate_sr from support_resistance)
   - If new S/R is available:
     a. Compare new support to entry-time support
     b. If new support is >10% lower than entry stop_loss: tighten stop
        new_stop = max(get_stop_loss(new_sr), pos['stop_loss'])  # ratchet up only
     c. If new resistance is >10% higher than entry target: widen target
        new_exit = get_exit_price(new_sr)
        pos['exit_price'] = max(pos['exit_price'], new_exit)  # ratchet up only
     d. Log: '[EXIT-MONITOR] {symbol}: S/R refreshed. Support {old}->{new}, Resistance {old}->{new}'

2. Save updated positions if any stop_loss or exit_price changed.

3. Important: stops only ratchet UP (tighter), targets only ratchet UP (wider profit). Never loosen a stop or lower a target.

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify range_scanner.py or support_resistance.py
- Import get_ohlcv and get_price from range_scanner
- Import calculate_sr and get_stop_loss and get_exit_price from support_resistance
- If S/R recalculation returns None (not enough data), keep existing levels
- Only update positions.json if values actually changed
